bug_summary: keyofメソッドで使われるUnionToTuple型が非末尾再帰になっており、キー数が多いオブジェクトスキーマに対してTSの「型のインスタンス化が深すぎる」エラーが発生していた問題を、アキュムレータ形式の末尾再帰に変更して修正。
pr_diff:
diff --git a/library/src/types/utils.ts b/library/src/types/utils.ts
index 14680c8e..e1905695 100644
--- a/library/src/types/utils.ts
+++ b/library/src/types/utils.ts
@@ -66,21 +66,14 @@ export type UnionToIntersect<TUnion> =
     : never;
 
 /**
- * Converts union to tuple type using an accumulator.
- *
- * For more information: {@link https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/release-notes/typescript-4-5.html#tail-recursion-elimination-on-conditional-types}
+ * Converts union to tuple type.
  */
-type _UnionToTuple<TUnion, TResult extends unknown[]> =
+export type UnionToTuple<TUnion> =
   UnionToIntersect<
     TUnion extends never ? never : () => TUnion
   > extends () => infer TLast
-    ? _UnionToTuple<Exclude<TUnion, TLast>, [TLast, ...TResult]>
-    : TResult;
-
-/**
- * Converts union to tuple type.
- */
-export type UnionToTuple<TUnion> = _UnionToTuple<TUnion, []>;
+    ? [...UnionToTuple<Exclude<TUnion, TLast>>, TLast]
+    : [];

pr_description: Collapses the accumulator-based _UnionToTuple/UnionToTuple pair into a single UnionToTuple type, building the tuple with a spread instead of threading an accumulator parameter through the recursive calls.
